ml_fit_policy: all post-calibration jamming/spoofing development rows; diagnostic in-sample replay; not causal validation
rule_fit_policy: fixed relative thresholds; no attack training; protocol chosen after legacy inspection, exploratory

benchmark.resource_gate: maximum empirical per-condition full-pipeline P95, with calibration separately reported and included conservatively when measured; no synthetic probes in gate
benchmark.stress_offer_validity: Report actual scheduled/arrival rates and producer lateness; include schedule delay in scheduled-to-ready misses; never claim sustained nominal rate when source cannot maintain it

statistical_policy: INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE: independence not established; no inferential bounds applied
real_time_policy: Sequential execution: one complete threshold/confirmation detector configuration and one original-rate session per fresh measured process, independent producer process; no simultaneous candidate processing. Only listed configs receive execution-clock results; others NOT EVALUATED operationally.
realtime_scope: Two primary confirmation=2 threshold0.5 causal rules; all other configs retain information-clock diagnostic replay and per-config resource measurements only
delay_aggregation: worst confirmed execution delay across all eligible sessions; any missed/readiness-failed episode = infinity
